definition: Only immutable entity and join key.
validation_rule: Unique within one target_universe_id and target_universe_version manifest; exact source value preserved.
interpretation_boundary: No symbol, base ID, or external identifier may replace it.

definition: Stable identifier for the universe definition family.
interpretation_boundary: An identifier labels scope; it does not imply scientific merit.

source_or_derivation: Definition, source hashes, rule hash, and generator hash
definition: Immutable version of one universe snapshot.
validation_rule: Must change if the definition, source artifacts, membership rules, or generator changes.
interpretation_boundary: Versions record evolution and are not ordered by target quality.

definition: Deterministic row order passed to Task #021 for included entities.
validation_rule: Unique and contiguous within one manifest; never derived from evidence strength.
interpretation_boundary: Row order is serialization metadata, not an ordering of scientific value.

definition: Entity state relative to this exact universe scope.
validation_rule: Exactly one controlled state per EnsemblID.
interpretation_boundary: EXCLUDED means outside scope, not biologically unfavorable.

definition: Exact deterministic rule that resolved membership.
validation_rule: Must resolve in the frozen rule set for this universe version.
interpretation_boundary: A rule establishes membership only and cannot encode therapeutic judgment.

definition: Machine-readable source path and field or governed event used by the rule.
validation_rule: No free-text or symbol-based fallback source.
interpretation_boundary: Source presence is not evidence quality.

definition: Neutral explanation of why the membership condition resolved.
validation_rule: Generated from a fixed template using governed values.
interpretation_boundary: Reasons cannot assert importance, low value, druggability, or clinical relevance.

definition: Governed artifacts that support the membership decision.
validation_rule: Unique, lexically sorted IDs; NONE forbidden for a resolved decision.
interpretation_boundary: Artifact identity is provenance, not biological support.

validation_rule: Every source artifact ID has exactly one verified hash.
interpretation_boundary: A hash proves content identity, not scientific validity.

definition: Timestamp of the governed membership snapshot.
validation_rule: Copied from configuration; never read from wall clock during row generation.
interpretation_boundary: Recency does not imply improved evidence or relevance.

definition: Snapshot time for INCLUDED rows; explicit sentinel otherwise.
validation_rule: Equals membership_timestamp only for INCLUDED; NOT_APPLICABLE for all other states.
interpretation_boundary: This field records entry into scope, not discovery or biological timing.

definition: Neutral scope reason for EXCLUDED rows; explicit sentinel otherwise.
validation_rule: Required for EXCLUDED and NOT_APPLICABLE for other states.
interpretation_boundary: Exclusion never means biologically bad or uninteresting.

definition: Availability state for permitted display annotations.
validation_rule: Cannot affect membership unless a future universe definition explicitly governs that annotation as a scope variable.
interpretation_boundary: Annotation absence cannot trigger manual identifier inference.

validation_rule: Never joined, repaired, or used as a fallback identifier.
interpretation_boundary: Symbols may change and are not entity identity.

validation_rule: Copied without recoding; any future scope use must be explicit and versioned.
interpretation_boundary: Gene type alone does not imply druggability or relevance.

definition: Generator identity used for this manifest.
validation_rule: Exact path and script hash are required.
interpretation_boundary: Generator identity does not validate scientific meaning.
